title: Boardroom presentation
description: Present a proposal to the board, handle questions, and negotiate with senior executives.
descriptionIt: Presenta una proposta al consiglio, gestisci le domande e negozia con i dirigenti.
setting: A formal boardroom at a multinational company. You are presenting a strategic proposal.
aiCharacter: Senior executive named Margaret. Direct, professional, and expects precise language.
goals: Open with a clear outline of your proposal
Respond to challenging questions with nuance
openingLine: Thank you for joining us. We have thirty minutes. Please begin whenever you are ready.
suggestedPhrases: Let me outline the three key points.
The key takeaway is that we must act now.
Rarely have we seen such an opportunity.
